case_title: Vaneet Mahajan v. State of Punjab & Ors.
aggravating_circumstances: Open declaration of intent to kill, use of deadly weapons, attack on unarmed persons
offence_finally_established: Attempt to murder under Section 307 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused attacked the victims, who were in a car, with sharp and deadly weapons, including swords, baseball bats, and daatars. The assailants smashed the car's glass and inflicted grievous injuries on the victims. Medical reports confirmed that the injuries were caused by sharp-edged weapons. The Special Investigation Team recovered weapons and vehicles used in the attack, and CCTV footage was examined. The prosecution alleged that the attack was carried out with the intention to kill the victims, as evidenced by the attackers' statements and the nature of the injuries inflicted.
